payload.claim: Criterion 2's requirement that a REBUT cap cut beside a lens with an error ends REVIEW_INCOMPLETE and keeps rebut_result requires the cell to guard the existing cap-cut block at saffron/cell/session.py:4044-4046 (which otherwise sets outcome to EXHAUSTED and clears rebut_result) so it does not fire on this new path. The spec states this requirement in prose (item 4's last sentence) but does not pin it to that line range the way the rest of the context section pins everything else. This is already covered by two explicit wrong_versions entries under criterion 2 and was proven buildable by the dated prototype, so it costs nothing to leave as a prose-only instruction.
